observations: Multiple retail boxes for Blue Gate UPS are stacked together.
The top box clearly displays 'BLUE GATE' and 'BG1230 Elite Pro'.
The box indicates it is a 'Line Interactive UPS'.
A watermark 'NG COMPUTERS' is visible across the center of the image.
The boxes appear to be in a warehouse or retail storage area.
The actual UPS units are not visible, only the outer packaging.

claims.evidence: The boxes are shown but the seals are not clearly visible, and the units inside are not shown.
The model name is clearly printed on the front of the box in photo 0.

risks.risk: The internal batteries may be dead or degraded from long-term storage.
risks.proof: A video showing the UPS powering a significant load (e.g., a PC or lamp) while unplugged from the wall.
risks.if_unproven: priced as requiring immediate battery replacement

risks.risk: The unit may be Dead on Arrival (DOA) or have a faulty inverter.
risks.proof: A video of the unit being turned on and successfully passing a self-test.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different/older model.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual unit out of the box showing the model sticker on the rear.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the model shown on the box

proof_requests: Photo of the actual UPS unit outside of the box.
Photo of the specification/serial number sticker on the back of the unit.
Video of the unit powered on and running a device while disconnected from mains power.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identifiable from the retail packaging in the photo. It will be priced at the worst-case functional state (not working) until proof of operation is provided.
